services.desc: An Intimate Trip for Six About We are a six-passenger vessel, making your sail a more private experience. While there may be several other people on your trip there is plenty of room to lounge about or you can sit with the crew and help us sail. It’s your trip, you tell us what you want, and we’ll do our best to make your vacation in Ogunquit a memorable one. Generally speaking, the sea is calmest and the winds lightest. 1 hour and 30 minutes Departs 9:30 am What to Expect Conditions at sea will be very much like being at the beach, but a little more extreme; windier, sunnier, or 9:30 am · 1.5 hour sail · 6 people maximum · Book in Advance
